original.statement: The Helm value `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` has been deprecated in Cilium 1.17.0 (now a no-op) and will be removed in Cilium 1.18.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Helm value hubble.relay.dialTimeout is no longer honoured: it is deprecated, now a no-op, and will be removed entirely in Cilium 1.18.

decision.reason: The values-key validator confirms that `hubble.relay.dialTimeout` exists in the chart in both releases [ev-28e0ccb5774a][ev-39a22d88e2f5], so the subject is right. However, [ev-4ce2886cea1f] says the option is "now a no-op" in 1.17, so a value that is set is no longer honoured. In this vocabulary, "deprecated" means the subject still works, so it does not fit; "removed" fits, because it covers a subject that "is no longer honoured", even though the key is still in values.yaml.
